en.settings.runtimeLoginRecheckIntervalSub: While Claude or Codex reads as logged out (or its check failed), how often each machine rechecks on its rounds; 30 means at every report. A change reaches each machine at its next report (30–3600 s)
en.settings.secretCardRetention: Secret Christmas card: kept after retrieval (unwrapped)
en.settings.secretCardRetentionRange: Kept after retrieval (unwrapping) must be a whole number between 0 seconds and 1 day
en.settings.secretCardRetentionSub: How long a value stays after the member first unwraps (retrieves) it (0 seconds to 1 day). It may be retrieved again until then; 0 deletes it at the first retrieval. Only affects later retrievals.
en.settings.secretCardUnretrievedTtl: Secret Christmas card: time left to unwrap (retrieve)
en.settings.secretCardUnretrievedTtlRange: Time to retrieve (unwrap) must be a whole number between 1 minute and 30 days
en.settings.secretCardUnretrievedTtlSub: How long after you provide a value it waits for the member to retrieve it before it is deleted and the Christmas card lapses (1 minute to 30 days). Only affects values provided later.
en.settings.sessionTtlSub: How long before you have to sign in to the village again
en.settings.stepNoteCapSub: How many characters one wish step's note may hold — the size of its gift tag. It can be lowered as well as raised, and lowering it loses nothing already written.
en.settings.suggestedRepliesChatSub: Sentences you can drop in with one tap when chatting with any member — like a quick greeting card.
en.settings.suggestedRepliesFull: That is 20 sentences, the maximum — the stocking is full. Remove one to add another.
en.settings.suggestedRepliesLoreMessageSub: Sentences you can drop in with one tap when messaging the writer of a tradition — fireside talk.
en.settings.suggestedRepliesReplyCardSub: Sentences you can drop in with one tap when answering a Christmas card — like signing the back of a card.
en.settings.suggestedRepliesTaskMessageSub: Sentences you can drop in with one tap when messaging on a wish — saves trudging through the snow.
en.settings.suggestedReplyPlaceholder: e.g. Got it, go ahead — merry Christmas
en.settings.suggestedReplyRemove: Remove this sentence from the stocking
